messages:
sam: Heads-up — PR #3472 (docs: auth-migration-guide) has a Netlify preview but the top nav links to /guides/auth are 404ing there. Can someone grab a reviewer and advise whether we should hold the merge until previews pass?
elaine: I saw the Netlify preview fail earlier, linkcheck in CI shows a 404 on /guides/auth/index.html. I'll take first pass.
sam: thanks! i'm pinging reviewers in the PR but wanted a quick sync here — ci said linkcheck flake, not universal.
jordan: I pulled the preview locally — the generated site is fine for me when I run `mkdocs serve` locally. Could be a difference in base_url or the artifact packaging on Netlify.
mel: Netlify deploy log shows a missing asset shard when it builds the _site bundle (artifact unzip step failed on one of the shards). See the netlify-bot report: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/12345 :warning:
ci-bot: Linkcheck failed in job `docs/preview-linkcheck` — failure at step `check-links` with exit code 2. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/3472/console
elaine: If local `mkdocs serve` is fine it's likely the preview build pipeline. Can we re-run the Netlify preview first? If it still fails, we should avoid merging until we confirm artifact integrity.
jordan: Quick workaround: change the nav link in the PR from `/guides/auth` to `guides/auth/index.html` to see if preview resolves (weird but will rule out base path handling). I can push a tiny commit.
sam: I'm leaning to re-run preview and try jordan's quick patch if it still fails. We want to avoid flipping the canary merge slot if the artifact is bad. Elaine — do you want to be reviewer for the patch?
elaine: Yep I can review the small link tweak, but if we end up needing to re-run Netlify builds multiple times we should open a follow-up to investigate shard uploads in the deploy pipeline.
mel: Agree — filing follow-up after merge if it's a transient. If artifact unzip fails again I'll escalate to eng-infra.
jordan: Pushed tiny commit to test absolute vs relative (hash: b3c2a7). Netlify preview retriggered.
ci-bot: Netlify preview started: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/12346
sam: Elaine — any blockers on review?
elaine: LGTM, small tidy. No content changes besides the href patch. Marked approved. :white_check_mark:
sam: thanks — i'm going to wait for the re-run to finish, if green i'll merge in the next merge window (we're in the late-afternoon slot so target 21:30 PT), otherwise hold and open infra ticket.
mel: noted — if it flakes again I'll post a short issue with logs and tag @eng-infra.
sam: great. will update the PR with merge timing. :thumbsup:
jordan: local repro steps if anyone needs them: `pip install -r docs/requirements.txt && mkdocs serve -a 127.0.0.1:8000` — then check /guides/auth.
elaine: Re-run came back ✅. Preview link shows resolved. Merging after the 21:30 slot.
sam: merging now within the agreed slot. Thanks everyone. :shipit:
